title: Vertex proxy tests go through VertexAIProvider.proxy, not the delegate
answers: where to test Vertex AI proxy behaviour
test placement for Vertex MaaS raw proxy
why does the Vertex proxy test call the top-level provider
body:
Convention: Tests for the Vertex raw proxy route call VertexAIProvider.proxy, not the MaaS delegate directly.
Why: VertexAIProvider forwards _proxy to its delegates, so going through the top-level provider exercises the full route that the gateway uses.
The new MaaS proxy tests (URL for chat/completions, v1/chat/completions, /v1/chat/completions, and streaming with text/event-stream) live in tests/gateway/providers/test_vertex_ai.py.
Constraints: Stated in the PR description; no reviewer comment backs it.
applies: Writing or updating tests for Vertex AI proxy behaviour in tests/gateway/providers/test_vertex_ai.py.
says: Streaming responses stall when proxying chat completions through the model gateway.
Chat completions fail when calling proxy endpoints with different URL path prefixes.
Model gateway should support real time event streaming for chat completion requests.
Chat completion requests fail to reach upstream providers through the raw proxy.
search: Tests for the Vertex AI raw proxy route must call VertexAIProvider.proxy rather than invoking the MaaS delegate directly. Calling VertexAIProvider in mlflow/gateway/providers/vertex_ai.py forwards _proxy to its delegates, exercising the complete route used by the gateway. In tests/gateway/providers/test_vertex_ai.py, tests cover chat completions URL variants and text/event-stream streaming, as stated in the PR description.
